signInStatement: Sign in to Pool Party. This will not start a transaction or cost any gas.

signIn.getStartedSubtitle: Create an account or sign in to continue.
signIn.termsPrefix: By continuing you agree to our

walletReady.title: Your wallet is ready
walletReady.subtitle: Secured on this device, with no seed phrase to write down.

connect.title: Connect a wallet
connect.subtitle: Choose how you'd like to connect.

learnWallets.title: New to wallets?
learnWallets.body: A crypto wallet holds your funds and signs your actions. It is your key to Pool Party. A full guide is coming soon; for now, Continue with Google creates one for you automatically.

sessionError.title: We could not verify your wallet
sessionError.bodyAuthRejected: Your wallet signature was not accepted, so we could not sign you in. This can happen when your wallet cannot be reached on-chain right now.
sessionError.bodyUserRejected: The signature request was declined, so we could not sign you in.
sessionError.bodyUnavailable: We could not finish signing you in. This is usually temporary.
sessionError.exhausted: We have stopped trying automatically. Send the reference below to support and we will look into it.
sessionError.signerBody: Your wallet is using a different address than the one it connected with. If you recognize the address below, select that account in your wallet and try again.
sessionError.bodyEmptySignature: Your wallet returned a signature that doesn't cover the sign-in message, so it cannot prove ownership of this address. Nothing is wrong with your account. Update your wallet app to the latest version, or connect the same account through a different wallet.
sessionError.titleEmptySignature: This wallet connection can't sign in
